caseName: Banco Nacional de Cuba v. Sabbatino
caseNameFull: Banco Nacional de Cuba v. Sabbatino, Receiver
attorneys: James A. Dixon on the motion.

opinions.text: Certiorari, ante, p. 905, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit. The motion of Pan-American Life Insurance Co. for leave to be heard as amicus curiae is granted to permit the filing of a brief but not to permit the presentation of oral argument.
